newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian smith killed after hammering cannon shell.
newsitem.headline: Russian smith killed after hammering cannon shell.

text.p: A blacksmith in a Russian village was killed by an explosion after hammering on a cannon shell he had used as an anvil for 10 years, the daily Komsomolskaya Pravda said on Tuesday.
The newspaper said someone had given him the shell a decade ago saying it was a training dummy.
The smith, who had never served in the army, had been using what he thought was just a heavy piece of metal as an improvised anvil.
"Now there is a deep hole in the ground instead of a village smithy," the daily said.
